title: MONOLITH-FEATURE-PARITY-DIRECTIVES
reconstruction_note: ⚠️ RECONSTRUCTED 2026-08-12 per the owner's rule (directive files are records — reconstruct, never drop). The original file was never committed. Built from qa-restore-verify.cjs (the committed RESTORE verification harness, which enumerates RESTORE-1/2/3/5/6/7 with per-item end-to-end gates) and BACKLOG.md B-N (which cites RESTORE-3 as its source). context_for_executor: Restore the old monolith build's signature features in the modular SPA — feature parity, not a port of the architecture. Each RESTORE item is gated end-to-end by qa-restore-verify.cjs (headless Chrome vs serve.cjs:8765, seeded demo project).

RESTORE-1.name: Risk matrix (probability x impact) with click-to-filter + clear
RESTORE-1.evidence: #risk-matrix populated (Very High tier, data-action="riskMatrixCell"); cell click filters the risk list to matching prob/impact rows; riskMatrixClear removes the filter and restores full rows.

RESTORE-2.name: Import Dates — Copy List button
RESTORE-2.evidence: copyIdTemplate action present in the Import Dates modal ('Copy List'); click copies the template and shows a 'Copied' toast.

RESTORE-3.name: Email templates (Status Update / Change Request / Risk Escalation / Closure Sign-Off)
RESTORE-3.status: EXECUTED — STATIC BASELINE (verified qa-restore-verify.cjs R3a/R3b) + AI-UPGRADE PATH COMPLETED (2026-08-12)
RESTORE-3.evidence: Four [data-action=emailTpl] buttons (kinds status..closure) copy ready-to-send drafts built live from state (App.emailTpl). Owner decision (2026-08-08): static baseline FIRST as the guaranteed zero-model fallback; the AI-upgrade path tracked separately as BACKLOG.md B-N — which is now IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-12): 'email' AI preset in mmgr-prompts.js + mmgr-ai.js LOCAL_BUILDERS.email returning App.emailTplText('status') verbatim on the local tier, cloud tier drafts a polished version. Static buttons unchanged and never depend on a model.

RESTORE-6.name: Save Charter
RESTORE-6.evidence: saveCharter action wired; writes charter.name to state and shows a 'Charter saved' toast.

RESTORE-7.name: WBS alerts banner (schedule-logic issues) with expand/collapse
RESTORE-7.evidence: #wbs-alerts renders when the schedule has issues ('schedule logic issue', tglWbsIssues); the toggle expands #wbs-issues-detail and collapses it again.

closing_note: All known RESTORE items verified end-to-end by qa-restore-verify.cjs (14/14 gates: R1a-R1c, R2/R2b, R3a/R3b, R5a/R5b, R6a/R6b, R7a-R7c — re-run against serve.cjs:8765). No open items remain from this directive.
